import datetime,json,urllib.request,base64,zlib
def now(): return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
def emit(label,obj): print(label+' '+base64.b64encode(zlib.compress(json.dumps(obj).encode())).decode(),flush=True)
for alias,expected in [('10.10.1.10','spoke1-backend-192.168.1.4\n'),('10.20.0.10','spoke2-backend-192.168.1.4\n')]:
 for attempt in range(3):
  url='http://'+alias+':8080/'
  proof=dict(startedAtUtc=now(),method='GET',url=url,attempt=attempt+1,timeoutSeconds=10,expected=expected)
  try:
   with urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=10) as r:
    proof.update(status=r.status,headers=dict(r.headers),body=r.read().decode())
   proof.update(completedAtUtc=now(),passed=proof['status']==200 and proof['body']==expected)
   emit('HUB_HTTP_Z',proof)
   assert proof['passed'], 'Wrong HTTP identity'
  except Exception as e:
   print('HUB_HTTP_FAILURE '+json.dumps(dict(proof,error=repr(e),completedAtUtc=now())),flush=True)
   raise
url='http://192.168.1.4:8080/'
proof=dict(startedAtUtc=now(),method='GET',url=url,timeoutSeconds=3,negativeControl=True)
try:
 with urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=3) as r:
  proof.update(status=r.status,body=r.read().decode(),unexpectedSuccess=True)
except Exception as e:
 proof.update(error=repr(e),expectedFailure=True)
proof['completedAtUtc']=now()
print('NEGATIVE_HTTP '+json.dumps(proof),flush=True)
